about.body2: Our work spans education, healthcare, and empowerment through community participation.

programs.title: Education for All
programs.sub: Scholarships and learning centers for underprivileged children
programs.details:
### Our Mission
Our Education for All initiative focuses on providing quality education to children from marginalized communities. 

### What We Do
- **Evening Centers**: We run evening learning centers for over 500 children.
- **Scholarships**: We offer merit-based scholarships to help students pursue higher education.
- **Free Supplies**: Distribute free school supplies, uniforms, and textbooks.

> *"Education is the most powerful weapon which you can use to change the world."*

programs.title: Health and Wellness
programs.sub: Free medical camps, medicines and health awareness drives
programs.details:
### Healthcare for Everyone
We organize monthly free medical camps in rural areas, offering:

1. General physical checkups
2. Eye and dental exams
3. Free basic medicines

Our health awareness drives educate communities on hygiene, nutrition, and preventative care.

programs.title: Livelihood Support
programs.sub: Skill development and micro-finance for rural communities
programs.details:
### Economic Independence
To foster economic independence, we provide skill development workshops in:
- **Tailoring & Sewing**
- **Computer Literacy**
- **Basic Mechanics**

We also offer micro-finance support to help families start small sustainable businesses.

programs.title: Women Empowerment
programs.sub: Self-help groups, vocational training and legal aid
programs.details:
### Empowering Women
Our Women Empowerment programs create **self-help groups** where women can save and invest together.

We offer specialized vocational training and free legal aid to ensure women are aware of and can protect their rights.

programs.title: Disaster Relief
programs.sub: Rapid response support for flood and earthquake victims
programs.details:
### Emergency Response
In times of natural calamities, our rapid response teams distribute:
- Emergency ration kits
- Clean drinking water
- Temporary shelter materials

We work closely with local authorities to ensure aid reaches the most affected areas quickly.

programs.title: Environment
programs.sub: Tree plantation drives and clean water initiatives
programs.details:
### A Greener Future
Committed to a greener future, we conduct regular **tree plantation drives** and maintain them with community support.

We also install water purification systems in schools and villages to ensure access to safe drinking water.

forms.name: Education Registration
forms.instructionText:
Add your Correct Full name ( check spelling too)  This Name will appear Certificate ( once its generated no option to revise)

Visit our website side and add your profile phot that also will appear on Certificate ( in you have not uploaded your photo certificate will generate without profile Photo)

Please update Mobile number correctly, all the future communication will upload in your my dashboard data which will link to your mobile number   

Select correct stream and sub-stream if its not appearing in drop down please select other and in next filed add your correct stream and sub stream together 

Supporting Document - Upload your Current year passed in academic year 2025-26 and if you got any academic year marksheet and passing certificate post Sep-2025 and
 you have not honored in our last year award function  then also you can apply , in that case keep your My dashboard in our website our team will ask few question.

Post submission you will get WhatsApp joining button , you have to connect our WhatsApp group where we will share you common information about event date, any other information too
